def.brief: Fix the independent review's findings in dwitbuk.py only (contract section Q-review-fixes): (1) the eyes request's candidate listing and its diff use --no-renames, so each side of a rename is judged by is_record on its own; (2) the kept literal pathspecs go to git in batches whose pathspec arguments stay within a new module-level int dwitbuk.PATHSPEC_BATCH_BYTES (default between 1024 and 262144), concatenated in git's order to the same text one call would give, possibly stopping once the diff passes its 80000-character cut with diff_truncated still true; (3) verify_packet's excluded_diff holds exactly what each excluded entry names under the strict rule — a bare entry only that file, never files under a directory that took its name — and an entry ending in / that directory's files; (4) an untracked entry git lists as a directory (an untracked nested repository) is never read as a file and is not in new_files. Keep everything Q-strict, Q-strict-sites and Q-strict-keep say. test_dwitbuk.py is the contract and protected: do not edit it, hooks/stop_eyes.py, README.md, the manifests, eyes_worker.py or hostcall.py, and do not commit. Run the suite with AGENT_WORKER unset (env -u AGENT_WORKER python3 test_dwitbuk.py): inside a worker session test_session_start_hook_says_what_the_placed_reviews_still_need_and_nothing_else fails only because that hook steps aside when AGENT_WORKER=1.
